detailed_descriptions.en: The kingdom is threatened by the mysterious Fungomancer. Unite the clans and face off against this common enemy. Choose unique insect with their specific abilities, focus on their synergies and place them strategically to overcome the dangers that come your way! In Hive Blight, you’ll start by choosing an alliance between two clans, shaping your available units, equipment, trinkets, and synergies. Each clan has its own playstyle: the Vespadas excel in offense and debuffs, the Silent Cabbale use poison and ambush tactics, and the Sweet Symphoney rely on healing and seduction. Combine the clan cleverly, like pairing the Cabbale’s ambush with the Vespadas’ brute force, and you might discover combos even we didn’t predict. Each clan comes with a panel of unique units with each their specific abilities and stats , it’s up to you to make a choice depending on your playstyle and what you get during your run. Focus on the synergies between their abilities to get the best out of each of them! Discover more than 40 unique characters The world is full of surprises! Explore its lush environment to find ways to improve your troops! Find or buy equipment , discover sacred altars with long lost powers, drink mysterious potions to boost your unit or visit the forge ! There are many ways for you to get stronger, make wise decisions on the road to get there! Discover more than 60 unique equipments and trinkets The Fungomancer has brought the blight to the kingdom. Push the Blight back and fight through powerful entities to reach its source! The kingdom depends on you!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The kingdom is threatened by the mysterious Fungomancer. Unite the clans and face off against this common enemy. Choose unique insect with their specific abilities, focus on their synergies and place them strategically to overcome the dangers that come your way!

In Hive Blight, you’ll start by choosing an alliance between two clans, shaping your available units, equipment, trinkets, and synergies. Each clan has its own playstyle: the Vespadas excel in offense and debuffs, the Silent Cabbale use poison and ambush tactics, and the Sweet Symphoney rely on healing and seduction.

Combine the clan cleverly, like pairing the Cabbale’s ambush with the Vespadas’ brute force, and you might discover combos even we didn’t predict.

Each clan comes with a panel of unique units with each their specific abilities and stats, it’s up to you to make a choice depending on your playstyle and what you get during your run. Focus on the synergies between their abilities to get the best out of each of them!

Discover more than 40 unique characters

The world is full of surprises! Explore its lush environment to find ways to improve your troops! Find or buy equipment, discover sacred altars with long lost powers, drink mysterious potions to boost your unit or visit the forge! There are many ways for you to get stronger, make wise decisions on the road to get there!

Discover more than 60 unique equipments and trinkets 

The Fungomancer has brought the blight to the kingdom.

Push the Blight back and fight through powerful entities to reach its source!

The kingdom depends on you!
